title: dev.answer
description: The app's answer to a dev.request: what the verb produced, or the refusal it ended in — a status and a sentence, which the gateway hands the console verbatim. One of the two, never both.

DevAnswer.description: What came of one dev.request, named by its id.

result.description: What the verb produced, as the verb's own answer: the call that opened, the run's id, the roster, the score.

DevRefusal.description: Why the verb did not run, in the words the console shows: the status it travels under, and the sentence.

status.description: The HTTP status the console's door answers with.

detail.description: The sentence, in the app's or the gateway's own words.
